market_question: Will the No to ten million Switzerland initiative be approved in Switzerland’s June 14, 2026 popular vote?
reasoning: The initiative aims to cap Switzerland's population at 10 million, requiring drastic immigration cuts. Historically, similar immigration‑limitation initiatives (except the narrow 2014 mass immigration vote) have been rejected, e.g., the 2020 limitation initiative failed with 61.7% No. The Federal Council and Parliament will recommend rejection, and the double majority of voters and cantons further reduces chances. The economic reliance on foreign workers and strong business opposition make approval unlikely, so the market's 33.5% implied probability is too high.
evidence_points: Federal Council likely to recommend rejection
Economic impact of immigration cuts would mobilize opposition
sources_consulted: News coverage of SVP 'No to 10 million Switzerland' initiative
Historical approval rates for Swiss popular initiatives
